column1: # app slots rather than making them tight to buy filesystem nobody needs.
#   nvs       Config lives here -- both core::Config and core::DeviceConfig
#             via the Arduino EEPROM emulation. 20KB against ~3KB used.
#   otadata   Which app slot booted last. Required for OTA.
#   app0/app1 4MB each. The image is nowhere near that; the headroom is
#             what stops a future feature turning into a partition change
#             which on a fielded device is a reflash rather than an update.
#   spiffs    LittleFS
#             "spiffs" because that is the label LittleFS.begin() looks for
#             by default -- the filesystem in it is LittleFS regardless.
# Name
